# Test fixtures

Drop `.cdr` files here and the fixture tests will pick them up automatically;
without them those tests skip, while the negative tests still run.

Fixtures are **not committed** (see `.gitignore`). CorelDRAW documents are
usually someone else's copyrighted artwork, and redistributing them in a public
repository is not ours to do. If you want fixtures in CI, add a file whose
redistribution rights are unambiguous -- one you authored, or one published
under CC0.
